parameters.name: AliasName
parameters.description: The alias in the vulnerability advisory.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the container cluster.
> You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

parameters.name: ClusterName
parameters.description: The name of the container cluster.

parameters.name: ContainerId
parameters.description: The container ID.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query. The value starts from 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: Dealed
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the vulnerability is handled. Valid values:

**y**: Handled.
**n**: Not handled.

parameters.name: Digest
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the container image.

parameters.name: Image
parameters.description: The name of the container image.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The container image instance ID.
> Invoke the [ListRepository](~~451339~~) operation of Container Registry and obtain the container image instance ID from the **InstanceId** response parameter.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the vulnerability.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The cluster namespace.
> You can call the [GetOpaClusterNamespaceList](~~GetOpaClusterNamespaceList~~) operation to query this value.

parameters.name: Necessity
parameters.description:
The priority levels of vulnerabilities to query. Separate multiple levels with commas (,). Valid values:

- **asap**: high
- **later**: medium
- **nntf**: low.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: Pod
parameters.description: The name of the pod.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the image repository. Valid values:
- **cn-beijing**: China (Beijing)
- **cn-zhangjiakou**: China (Zhangjiakou)
- **cn-hangzhou**: China (Hangzhou)
- **cn-shanghai**: China (Shanghai)
- **cn-shenzhen**: China (Shenzhen)
- **cn-hongkong**: Hong Kong (China)
- **ap-southeast-1**: Singapore
- **ap-southeast-5**: Indonesia (Jakarta)
- **us-east-1**: US (Virginia)
- **us-west-1**: US (Silicon Valley)
- **eu-central-1**: Germany (Frankfurt)
- **eu-west-1**: UK (London).

parameters.name: RepoId
parameters.description:
The ID of the image repository.
> Call the [ListRepository](~~145293~~) operation of Container Registry and obtain the value of the **RepoId** response parameter.

parameters.name: RepoInstanceId
parameters.description:
The container image instance ID.
> Invoke the [ListRepository](~~451339~~) operation of Container Registry and obtain the container image instance ID from the **InstanceId** response parameter.

parameters.name: RepoName
parameters.description:
The name of the image repository.
> Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: RepoNamespace
parameters.description:
The namespace of the image repository.
> Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: RepoRegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the image repository. Valid values:
- **cn-beijing**: China (Beijing)
- **cn-zhangjiakou**: China (Zhangjiakou)
- **cn-hangzhou**: China (Hangzhou)
- **cn-shanghai**: China (Shanghai)
- **cn-shenzhen**: China (Shenzhen)
- **cn-hongkong**: Hong Kong (China)
- **ap-southeast-1**: Singapore
- **ap-southeast-5**: Indonesia (Jakarta)
- **us-east-1**: US (Virginia)
- **us-west-1**: US (Silicon Valley)
- **eu-central-1**: Germany (Frankfurt)
- **eu-west-1**: UK (London).

parameters.name: ScanRange
parameters.description:
The scan scope. Valid values:

- **image**: Image.
- **container**: Container.

parameters.name: StatusList
parameters.description:
The fix status of the vulnerability. Valid values:
- **1**: Unfixed.
- **4**: Being fixed.
- **7**: Fixed.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag of the container image.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The vulnerability type. Valid values:
- **cve**: system vulnerability
- **sca**: application vulnerability.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description: The UUIDs of images. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
